objective: Consolidate validated Floor Governance Cell and Agent Execution Fabric work and finish durable human-in-the-loop execution recovery without changing authority ownership.

rulesConsidered: AEF narrows sequencing and tool exposure but does not mint authority.

changes: Consolidates FGC governance and AEF execution work into one final integration branch.
Adds durable hash-chained human approval ledger.
Adds WAITING execution state with approvalId binding.
Adds approval state-version and execution-state fingerprint binding.
Adds restart-safe HITL recovery: pending waits remain waiting, expired/rejected/missing approvals block, approved waits do not auto-execute.
Adds expiry handling and stale approval protection.
Adds regression coverage for persistence, restart, state binding, expiry and no-auto-resume.
Updates AEF CI to typecheck the durable approval store.

security.notes: Approval is durable state, not a capability grant. Resume requires exact execution state binding. No credentials, secrets, or new authority levels added.

Merge only PR #47 into main if the final gates are green; close superseded PRs #44/#46 afterward.

dispositionRationale: Consolidated candidate is not yet fully validated; no main-branch merge claimed.
